hr tag produces a horizontal separator between content

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Before rule.</p><hr><p>After rule.</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
```
